unit.why: The division strings together five separately transmitted anecdotes about the Besht's trembling and power in prayer, ending with the Yom Kippur story of R. David and Samael.

stories.end_quote: והוצרכו להמתין בקריאת התורה עד שנח מרעדתו
stories.summary_en: On Rosh Hodesh or Hol ha-Moed of Pesach the Besht trembled so violently before Hallel that R. Wolf Kutzes and R. Avraham led him to the prayer stand, and the Torah reading had to wait until his trembling stopped.

tags.why: The Besht's trembling is the subject of the story.
The story is set during Hallel and the cantor's repetition of the prayer.

quotes: שהיה ר"ח או חה״מ של פסח
tags.why: It takes place on Rosh Hodesh or Hol ha-Moed of Pesach.

quotes: ועומדים בלי תנועה כמו גוסס ח"ו
tags.why: He stands rapt and motionless, as if absent from his body.
His face burns like torches.
The scene takes place in the Medzhybizh study hall.
The story depicts ecstatic fervor in prayer.

quotes: ולקחו אותו זה ביד אחד וזה ביד אחד
tags.why: His disciples assist him to the prayer stand.

stories.start_quote: ולא זו בלבד אלא ששמעתי מהרב
stories.summary_en: The author of Toldot Yaakov Yosef reported that water in a large vessel moved visibly while the Besht prayed, a sign of the indwelling Shekhinah.

tags.why: The water trembles with his prayer.
The event happens while the Besht prays.
Water moving on its own is a visible supernatural sign.

quotes: מפני אשר ירד עליו ה ׳ באש
tags.why: The event is explained through a verse.

stories.start_quote: גם שמעתי מהמ״מ מ׳ אליהו ז"ל
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Mezeritch told R. Eliyahu that on a festival, when he touched the Besht's kittel to smooth it, he and the table began to tremble until he prayed for the experience to be taken from him.

tags.why: The Maggid and the table tremble at his touch.
The kittel is the medium of the event.

quotes: פ"א בי״ט ואין יודע אם יו' ראשון של פסח
tags.why: It takes place on a festival.
The Besht leads the prayers.
The Maggid is a central character.
The Maggid tells the tale to a newcomer.

quotes: כשבא פעם ראשון ל המגיד הגדול
tags.why: R. Eliyahu comes to the Maggid for the first time.

quotes: הכיר בו כי אינו בזה העולם
tags.why: The Maggid perceives the Shekhinah resting on the Besht.

quotes: הכיר בו כי אינו בזה העולם
tags.why: The Besht is shown absorbed in God.
The scene is in the study hall and its side room.
The story concerns the Maggid's encounter with the Besht's holiness.

quotes: הי' הבעש״ט מתפלל לפני התיב' בחשק גדול
tags.why: He prays with great fervor.
The Maggid's illness is mentioned, but no healing occurs; weak fit.

stories.summary_en: While the Besht prayed in a house on a journey, the grain in barrels by the opposite wall was seen to tremble.

tags.why: The grain trembles.

quotes: התפלל הבעש״ט בדרך בבית בכותל מזרח
tags.why: The event happens during his prayer.
It takes place on a journey.
Grain moving on its own is a visible supernatural sign.

stories.start_quote: וגם שמעתי ממנו אבל לא מפיו
stories.summary_en: On Yom Kippur the Besht delayed the prayers and then publicly humiliated the cantor R. David; afterwards he explained that Samael was lying in wait for the prayers, and he had broken R. David's heart so no stray thought would let Samael seize them.

quotes: שפ"א ביה״כ בהשכמה לא בא הבעש״ט
tags.why: The story is set on Yom Kippur.
The story centers on the Yom Kippur prayers.

quotes: התחיל הבעש"ט לבזותו בפני כל עם ועדה
וביזה וגינה אותו ערך חצי שעה
tags.why: R. David is publicly shamed.
Samael appears as an agent.

quotes: שלא יהיה לך שום מחשב' זרה בלבך
tags.why: The point is to prevent stray thoughts in prayer.
The Besht perceives Samael's ambush.

quotes: פניתי דרך אחד שילכו התפלות בזו הדרך
tags.why: He protects the community's prayers.
The Besht struggles against Samael.
The hidden reason for the humiliation is revealed afterwards.

quotes: כי אמר שמא ח"ו ראה בי דבר מגונ'
tags.why: R. David fears he has been found sinful.
Broken-heartedness is induced deliberately.

quotes: לא בא הבעש״ט לבית המדרש כפי המנהג
tags.why: The scene is set in the study hall.

quotes: מקום שהתפילו' הולכי' לקבל כל התפילות
tags.why: The path of prayers to the upper worlds is described.

quotes: ואמר לו רבינו מה ראית בי
tags.why: The exchange is between the master and his cantor-disciple.

quotes: וסיפר על הדרך וכשבאו אנשי הקהלה
tags.why: The tale was told on the road to an engagement.
The narrator's role as a shochet frames the transmission.

quotes: ועשה ר׳ דוד מכפר תלאדווקע תנאים
tags.why: An engagement contract is the setting of the telling.
